verdict.rationale: Rippling's payroll page claims it automatically calculates payroll taxes and files them with the correct federal, state, and local agencies on time, which implies state-level withholding within its own payroll product. Location-aware labor policy enforcement in Time & Attendance adds adjacent support for multi-location workforces. The evidence is a single marketing claim, though: it never explicitly covers employees spread across multiple states or state tax registration. missing for 10: documented state tax account registration support, explicit multi-state/per-employee state withholding configuration (e.g., work vs. resident state handling), independent or hands-on corroboration.
